readability.limit: Whitespace, PaintSprayItem local context/targetPos names, three source-backed comments; no gameplay change.

assets.scope: All25 maintained JSON triples and24 current family PNGs. PNG CRC/deflate/decode and pixel D4 fingerprints are file analysis, not GPU output or original-PNG equivalence.

finite_source_witnesses.kind: Finite source and current-asset analysis, not actual target execution, packet delivery, shader output or gameplay.

vertical_wood_front.original: overlay_front/top or bottom by world side
vertical_wood_front.limit: Original family PNGs not found in the bounded original src/main/resources listing. Metal front images can be D4-equivalent; no claim all25 are visibly wrong.

excluded_paint_candidate.case: Tank source declaration has no direct Paintable interface, but its actual mixed-in BlockEntity ancestor does.
excluded_paint_candidate.chain: Both configured BlockEntityPaintMixin targets supply Paintable; PaintSprayItem dispatch reaches it, and BlockPaintColorMixin reads its painted state.
excluded_paint_candidate.positive: All25 also have base-material block/item tint routes; Neo ItemColorARGB adds opaque alpha to the registered base handler.
excluded_paint_candidate.limit: Excludes missing-paint-target claim, without accepting all mixed-in save/reload/item-color alpha or actual client behavior.

last_cover_snapshot.case: Same loaded fallback tank owner already has one client cover; server removes its last cover and a cover-only empty snapshot is received.
last_cover_snapshot.server: Fresh tag has no gt_cover_* or gt.component_covers; tick detects change and sends before untracking.
last_cover_snapshot.current_client: read returns before storage.load, leaving the old slot and active renderer owner.
last_cover_snapshot.original: receiveDataCovers null clears mCovers; CoverData.setIDs replaces zero-slot behaviors.
last_cover_snapshot.limit: Dedicated native cover hosts, another remaining cover, replacement entity or later full nonempty snapshots are separate cases. Do not clear arbitrary partial/item NBT reads just because fields are absent.
